title: A BOM stream rewinds its prefetched bytes
summary: The wrapper and its delegate can have different positions after a one-byte preview. Reset must restore the correct remaining bytes and EOF.

change.description: The wrapper and its delegate can have different positions after a one-byte preview. Reset must restore the correct remaining bytes and EOF.

notes: The independent JVM oracle covered 36 inputs on each revision. parent mismatches were 10 for bytes, 0 for eof. fix mismatches were 0 for bytes, 0 for eof.
